what: A box open on both sides (6.4×4×4, 45° field-of-view camera at (0, 2.5, 9)) with Work videos·photos on four faces (front, top, back, bottom) floats tilted at y −30° and x .25, then rolls 90° on the x axis per step (.9s power2.inOut, +.25s per step for multiple steps, max 2.5s). With only four faces, at half the roll the picture on the unseen face is swapped so the top face always shows the next Work, and only the current face’s video plays. Clicking rotates it to front (x −.278) and enlarges it to fill the screen (.65s power3.inOut), then fx:pick. During the enlargement, on fx:next it shrinks by .35 to normal size, and .25 later rolls and fills again. Only while Space is held is physics on (gravity −18, floor −1.5, side walls ±3.5), so you can drag and throw with the mouse, and on release it returns in place with .7s power2.out. On entry, it rolls in from off-screen right at x 19, making one turn on the z axis, with 2.2s power2.inOut. On phone width, a tall box (3.5×6×6) fills the screen from the front and shrinks (.5), rolls, and grows again by the scroll progress value of fx:progress

options.dur: Duration of one cell roll (s), default .9
options.extra: Extra length (seconds) added per slot when moving across several slots, default .25
options.max: Max length across multiple cells (sec), default 2.5
options.wheel: One step per wheel turn — ancestor selector that receives the wheel (e.g. main) or self. If none, the wheel is ignored. After a turn, the next wheel is blocked for lock ms
options.entry: If true, it waits off-screen and rolls in when it receives fx:enter (after the loader)
options.zoom: If false, does not zoom on press
options.physics: If false, turns off the space physics (turns off automatically when CANNON is missing or on touch devices)
options.narrow: Below this width (px) use the phone box (tall box, scroll progress value), default 768
options.[data-fx-part=face]: Work one —
options.--fx-face-bg · --fx-face-ink: Placeholder surface background and line color, default --kf-contrast-bg · --kf-contrast-ink
options.fx:go: Event to send — rolls by the detail.step cell (override the length with detail.dur)
options.fx:progress: Outgoing event (phone) — detail.p is the progress value per cell, detail.intro runs 0 to 1 (box goes from .5x to 1x)
options.fx:enter · fx:zoom-out · fx:next: Events sent — enter · zoom out · next task while still zoomed in
options.fx:step · fx:settled · fx:hover · fx:zoo: Events received — roll start (step · index · dur · delay) · stop · aim (over · front) · zoom start · zoom end (index · time) · physics on/off (on) · request to release zoom (if preventDefault is called, fire fx:zoom-out directly)

note: The original puts a ms-unit frame interval into a physics step that expects seconds, always pushing .05s, so falling is three times faster — we keep that feel as is. The box is a MeshBasicMaterial so there is no lighting, and face artwork is drawn onto a canvas with cover and attached.
